method: Chemical-pathway composition of human feces, recomputed with X-compound pathway predictions added to the named metabolites the Global Discovery Panel detects. Detection is GDP, not MFP. Predicted pathways carry 52.2% measured super-pathway agreement against independent labels, so this shows direction and rough size rather than a measurement.

detection_basis.x_compounds: present in the human-feces detection history
